round1: Marc led Round 1 with 13 points, which was mostly a tribute to how bad everyone else was. Ottawa was picked by four of you for the third year running, and by the third year running it lost, this time to a Buffalo team only Jaclyn believed in.
round2: Jaclyn picked all four series in six games and got a monster 30 points out of it, nailing Toronto, Dallas and Colorado with the right length. Stephanie picked the wrong team in three of four series and went home with 2 points.
round3: Derrick snatched the lead with the only perfect read on Buffalo in 5, while Chrissy was the only one to nail Dallas in 7. Jaclyn, who led going in, picked Toronto and Colorado, both wrong, and scored a zero.
round4: Everybody picked Buffalo, Dallas won in six, and nobody scored. That makes it three years running of Marc, Derrick and Stephanie picking the wrong Cup winner, which at this point is a lifestyle.
overall: Derrick won his first pool with 39 points, edging Jaclyn (35) and Marc (33) after a Round 3 in which the lead changed hands for the second time. Stephanie finished last with 17 after a 2-point second round and a third straight wrong Cup pick. Not a single person picked Dallas in the Final, which is the sort of group consensus you only get from a group that has not been paying attention.
